title: 时尚的胶囊海报
prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, stylish poster [1080x1080] aspect ratio featuring a horizontal tablet-capsule hovering above a surface covered in condensation and water droplets, with its shadow cast on the wet ground. One side of the capsule is transparent glass, while the other is glossy [COLOR/DESIGN] plastic, displaying the [BRAND] logo and name. Seamlessly floating inside the glass portion of the capsule is a photorealistic 3D model of the [LOGO], perfectly centered and suspended in zero gravity. The glass and plastic surfaces showcase strong reflections, refractions, and environmental distortions. The background is a softly blurred, elegant light-toned setting. Use a dynamic perspective with a stylish camera angle, professional studio lighting, and ultra-high detail to make the image look like a DSLR-captured photograph with impeccable realism.
description: 借助 Nano Banana Pro 模型，打造超写实风格的胶囊海报，适用于品牌宣传、摄影展示和景观主题营销，通过光泽色彩与冷凝效果增强视觉真实感。
